mapper.sql: SELECT r.tenant_id, t.collection_key, t.id AS task_id, t.task_revision_no, r.questionnaire_id, r.response_id, r.id AS result_id, r.result_version, q.template_revision_id, r.rule_version, r.threshold, t.source_owner_context, t.source_object_type, t.source_object_id, t.source_object_version, r.passed, r.result_status, r.archive_status, r.version AS fact_version FROM acc_satisfaction_result r JOIN acc_satisfaction_collection_task t ON t.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND t.id=r.collection_task_id AND t.deleted=b'0' JOIN acc_satisfaction_questionnaire q ON q.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND q.id=r.questionnaire_id AND q.deleted=b'0' WHERE r.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND r.id=#{query.resultId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM acc_satisfaction_result WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE acc_satisfaction_result SET deliverable_source_version_id=#{query.deliverableSourceVersionId}, archive_status=#{query.archiveStatus}, archive_failure_code=#{query.archiveFailureCode}, archive_retry_count=#{query.archiveRetryCount}, version=version+1, updater=#{query.updater}, update_time=NOW(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id=#{query.resultId} AND version=#{query.expectedFactVersion} AND (deliverable_source_version_id IS NULL OR deliverable_source_version_id <= #{query.deliverableSourceVersionId})

UPDATE acc_satisfaction_result SET result_status='INVALIDATED', effective_to=#{query.invalidatedAt}, invalidated_by_user_id=#{query.actorUserId}, invalidated_at=#{query.invalidatedAt}, invalidation_reason_code=#{query.reasonCode}, invalidation_reason_summary=#{query.reasonSummary}, version=version+1, updater=#{query.updater}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id=#{query.resultId} AND version=#{query.expectedFactVersion} AND result_status='EFFECTIVE' AND passed=b'1' AND effective_to IS NULL
